# Sparkle 2.10.0

Official binary distribution: https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/releases/tag/2.10.0

`Sparkle-2.10.0.tar.xz` SHA-256:
`c2bf58aa8387266ac179357b1415d6f2635f044da8be41042af32425dae6da0c`

`Tools/prepare-sparkle.sh` verifies this pinned archive and extracts the framework and release tools to the ignored `.build/Sparkle` directory. Builds do not need to download dependencies. The original license is included in this directory and in the app.
